# GTMiQ

> Signal-based outbound engine for B2B SaaS companies (Seed to Series A) scaling sales into new regions. Built and run by David Mustač from Zagreb, Croatia. Every outbound message references a real, verifiable fact about the prospect — their growth rate, a specific customer, a strategic move — instead of templates.

GTMiQ is a service of Ascendia (ascendia.ceo). Founder: David Mustač (MEng AI/Automation, University of Rijeka). Operator background: Bitget, MasterBlox, Seedify, Thespian, Resomnium.

## What GTMiQ does

- Builds complete outbound pipeline systems in ~4 weeks: ICP scoring framework (0-100, signal-based), research engine (n8n workflows + Claude agents that research before writing), signal-based outreach sequences, CRM integration, documented playbook with Loom training.
- Methodology built on 2.5 years of B2B outreach pattern data — LinkedIn messages that booked meetings and call transcripts from closed deals, encoded into reusable skills.
- Target reply rate: 6-10% (vs 1-3% industry average for template outbound). Deliberately low volume: ~5 well-researched prospects per rep per week.

## Services and pricing

- **Build & Handoff** — full outbound system delivered in ~4 weeks, team runs it after handoff. From EUR 1,500 one-time. Quality guarantee: rework included if a deliverable misses spec.
- **Build & Run** — same 4-week build, then David runs the system for 8 more weeks (sends, replies, qualified meetings booked into the calendar). From EUR 3,500/month, 3 months recommended. Priced to deal size; results target written into the contract.
- **Monthly Retainer** — ongoing weekly optimization after a build. From EUR 1,500/month, 30-day cancellation notice.
- Fixed price. No commission, no equity. EU invoicing (reverse-charge VAT).

## Who it's for

B2B SaaS or tech companies, Seed to Series A, entering markets where nobody knows them yet. Small sales teams (2-6 people) or founders still running sales alone. Works mostly with European startups (London, Berlin, Amsterdam, Stockholm, Paris, CEE) and US companies where the fit makes sense.
